title: Injective module H1 vanishing
statement: For a scheme Y and commutative ring Λ, an injective sheaf J of Λ-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] has subsingleton degree-one cohomology of its underlying abelian sheaf, where H¹ is Ext out of the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

proof.text: View J as a module over the constant ring sheaf Λ; this equivalence preserves injectivity and the underlying abelian sheaf. Apply Stacks 03FD (the injective-module abelian acyclicity argument) at the terminal etale object Y, then identify derived section cohomology with Ext from the constant integer sheaf. The existing node states this with small-universe coefficients, SheafOfModules and rightDerived evaluation, so the constant-ring module equivalence, arbitrary coefficient universe and Ext comparison are still needed here.

from.place: proof step (ii), strict henselian base: injective acyclicity
